name: YouTube
description: Channels you choose, plus trending and search with a free YouTube API key. Plays in YouTube's official player.
author: Fanoos

settings.label: Channels (links, @handles or UC… ids)
settings.help: Separate with commas. Example: https://www.youtube.com/@NASA, UCAuUUnT6oDeKwE6v1NGQxug. @handles need the API key below; channel links and UC… ids work without it. Defaults: NASA, TED, Kurzgesagt, Veritasium.

settings.label: YouTube Data API key (optional)
settings.help: Enables Trending and Search. Free from console.cloud.google.com → YouTube Data API v3.
